expectations: Tickets are vertical slices that each cut through the layers end to end (view/endpoint/UI/tests), not one ticket per layer
Every ticket states which tickets block it, or that it can start immediately
The blocking edges are acyclic and every blocker comes before the tickets it blocks
The agent presents the proposed breakdown and asks the user to confirm granularity and edges before publishing or writing ticket files

evals.prompt: We need user_id renamed to account_id everywhere (database column, API field, SDK and all call sites, see README). Break this into tickets.
expectations: The breakdown treats this as a wide refactor sequenced expand-contract: first add account_id beside user_id, then migrate call sites in batches, then remove user_id
Each migrate batch is blocked by the expand ticket, and the contract ticket is blocked by every migrate batch
Every ticket states its blocking tickets or that it can start immediately
The agent asks the user to confirm the breakdown before publishing or writing ticket files
